_comment: Copy to price_sheet.json and fill in the per-million-token rates you are actually billed at, read from Anthropic's pricing page at the time you refresh; this example ships zeroed placeholders so that no rate is asserted by the repo itself (#3744). Dollars are computed when dump_churn.py runs, so re-dispatch retro_churn_dump.yml after editing the sheet. Without price_sheet.json the churn view reports tokens only and omits dollars entirely. `default` is used for any model with no explicit entry; keys are USD per 1,000,000 tokens.
